teaching.canDo: Use a controlled repricing comparison to identify the cost of waiting in the case.
teaching.keyIdea: A time-only comparison must hold spot and volatility fixed.

explanation.text: A premium change can mix several drivers. Theta isolates sensitivity to time while other model inputs stay fixed. In the case, the index moved and implied volatility fell as a day passed, so the total loss cannot be called time decay alone. The desk rule EV-3.1 asks for a same-spot next-day repricing. For a controlled comparison, also hold volatility and other pricing inputs fixed. Record both input sets. An entry theta is a local estimate, not an exact multi-day forecast. The rounded case attribution is a model explanation of this past example, not a measured future loss.

checks.prompt: What must a controlled EV-3.1 comparison keep fixed?
options: The final loss irrespective of inputs
Only the date of the quote

distractorRationale.Only the date of the quote: error: Holds a label fixed rather than the pricing inputs
distractorRationale.Only the realised closing price: error: Uses the realised endpoint instead of a controlled spot input
distractorRationale.The final loss irrespective of inputs: error: Works backwards from a total loss rather than isolating time

checks.explanation: Moving several inputs at once cannot isolate time; the comparison changes the time remaining alone.

checks.prompt: Why is the entire overnight loss not theta in this case?
options: Spot and IV changed as well
checks.answer: Spot and IV changed as well

distractorRationale.Theta only applies to puts: error: Incorrectly restricts theta to put options

checks.explanation: The observed change mixes drivers, whereas theta describes sensitivity to time with other inputs fixed.

options: Both input sets plus model values
checks.answer: Both input sets plus model values

distractorRationale.Yesterday was simply unlucky: error: Records a feeling without reproducible inputs
distractorRationale.Only the final percentage loss: error: Records an output without its assumptions

checks.explanation: Input sets let a reviewer reproduce the controlled comparison; a result alone cannot explain the assumptions.

checks.prompt: The rounded case time attribution is minus 23 per unit. For 300 units, what is that rounded component?

distractorRationale.Minus 300 rupees: error: Uses quantity as a cash amount
distractorRationale.Minus 2300 rupees: error: Drops a factor of three in the multiplication

checks.explanation: Multiply the rounded per-unit component by quantity. Rounded components need not equal the exact fill-based loss.

checks.prompt: Why is entry theta times three not necessarily an exact three-day value change?
options: Theta changes as model inputs evolve
Theta is a fixed annual fee
checks.answer: Theta changes as model inputs evolve

distractorRationale.Theta is a fixed annual fee: error: Mistakes a local sensitivity for a fixed fee
distractorRationale.Only the strike sets theta: error: Ignores every input other than strike
distractorRationale.Time has no pricing effect: error: Denies the pricing role of time

checks.explanation: Theta is a local model sensitivity that can change; a finite-period comparison requires repricing.
